size.description: Controls the modal window size and action button layout.

hasOptionalAction.description: Whether to show an optional third action button.

hasLeadingIcon.description: Whether to show the leading icon slot in the header.

hasCancelAction.description: Whether the window draws its Cancel button (and its label).

hasCloseAction.description: Whether the window draws the close button of its title bar.

leadingIconName.description: The icon in the `leading-icon` slot, by name (a bundled icon); empty puts none. Slot for an icon to appear before the title (shown when hasLeadingIcon is true)

title.description: The title of the window; empty keeps the element's own word, Title.

content.description: The text in the content area; empty leaves it blank. The element's `content` slot takes any content, which the module cannot hold, so only text is carried.

optionLabel.description: The label of the optional action button, drawn while `hasOptionalAction` is true; empty keeps the element's own word, Option.

cancelLabel.description: The label of the Cancel button, drawn while `hasCancelAction` is true; empty keeps the element's own word, Cancel.

doneLabel.description: The label of the Done button; empty keeps the element's own word, Done.

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
